summary: A line from {honoree}'s campaign displaces the quotation beneath the portrait.
realLife: In reviewing Chisholm's medal, the committee recommended replacing a statement about change with the slogan she had run on.
gates: Members have a portrait design and two documented choices for its inscription.
inGame: needs: portrait inscription and alternative campaign wording.

turns.what: The campaign line stays off the medal.
turns.pulledBy: The motion to substitute it fails.
turns.writesBack: The earlier inscription remains in the recommendation.

turns.what: The board asks to see the slogan on the reverse.
turns.pulledBy: The portrait side has little space.
turns.writesBack: Both placements go back to the artist.
